attributes.risk_rating_note: Residual-risk acceptance is open. Determine the minimum resolvable target size across the required range and viewing geometry. Validate the resolution boundary and any complementary lidar/infrared support; document where the detection target is not met.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Define the credited sensor set and performance boundary per operating condition. Validate day/night and reduced-visibility allocation with all sensors functioning as specified, and document when an operator warning or operating restriction is required.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Validate unusual poses across viewpoints, motion, and partial visibility using independent scenario data. Compare missed detections with the linked performance requirements and record limitations and mitigations.

Initial assessment: valid RGB and lidar data alone do not establish the required detection performance for camouflaged, partly concealed tigers. Decision: add a separate LWIR channel and evaluate qualified thermal evidence together with RGB and lidar before tiger classification. Runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001 is Done and is reflected in the current system and software architecture. Resulting requirements: TDS_SEN_003 and TDS_SEN_007. Residual-risk acceptance remains open. Validate the benefit, false alarms and warning delay using independent scenarios, including insufficient exposed target area, low thermal contrast (Case C2), range and environmental attenuation. Thermal sensing does not reveal a tiger through opaque cover; sensor diversity alone is not evidence of independence or adequate performance.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Evaluate pose-dependent classification misses and delay using independent labelled fused inputs. Investigate representation and training-data coverage, confidence thresholds and temporal confirmation; check false-positive tradeoffs after changes. Relate this evidence to integrated system Case A without counting the same scenario twice. Implementation changes and validation remain open.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Case C2 assesses the limitations of thermal sensing introduced by runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001 for Case C1. Validate near-background target temperatures across thermal crossover, sun-heated backgrounds and representative operating conditions. Include camouflaged and partially concealed targets to assess the combined C1/C2 scenario. Establish the remaining contrast boundary and the contribution of complementary modalities. Attach scenario results before accepting residual risk.

Residual-risk acceptance is open. Validate operating-condition monitoring sensitivity, thresholds, and warning response with heavy rain, sustained glare, and obstruction scenarios. Link threshold justification and scenario evidence; do not assume the monitor observes every limiting condition.
